mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, measured by quarter-over-quarter percent change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth (YoY % change) crosses above 4%, it signals a supply-side recovery that will boost equity prices over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts negative 20-day returns in > 50% of instances where INDPRO YoY growth exceeds 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate (0.5pp or more in 3 months) signals a labor market tightening that will drive wage inflation and compress profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 40% of 60-day windows following a 0.5pp+ UNRATE drop.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth (YoY % change) and retail sales growth (YoY % change) both exceed 6%, it signals a demand boom that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC of the interaction term remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the CPI inflation rate (YoY % change) exceeds 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 40% of 60-day windows when both FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth (3-month moving average) exceeds 250k jobs per month, it signals a labor market boom that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts negative 20-day returns in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS 3mo MA > 250k.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth (YoY % change) is negative and the unemployment rate is rising, it signals a supply-side recession risk that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC of the interaction term remains below -0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales growth (YoY % change) is negative for two consecutive months, it signals a demand slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY % change < 0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 40% of 20-day windows following two months of negative RSAFS YoY growth.
